description: Validate an operator-approved local MOGRT brand kit before using it in a template or batch preview. It never reads font inventories, image pixels, or writes files.

brand_kit.description: Approved brand-kit values to validate before recipe use.

font_family.description: PostScript font name for the template text (for example Halogen-Bold). Use a font from Adobe Fonts: After Effects will not export a template with other fonts unattended.

safe_margin_percent.description: Title-safe margin: 2-25 (percent) or 0.02-0.25 (fraction of the frame); default 10%.

name: validate_mogrt_brand_kit

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Validate Mogrt Brand Kit
